title: Separated classical and raw resolution comparisons
statement: For an injective resolution I of F on a scheme X, an open U, a restricted-resolution section comparison R [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices], and q≥0, define a_q from classical cohomology of F restricted to U to H^q(Γ(U,I extended by zero)). For f:X→Y, V open in Y and U=f⁻¹V, define b_f from this raw section cohomology to local hypercohomology of Rf_*F[0], using the normalized inverse-open and local Leray models [def-weil-pbc-derived-square-local-models]. Then the existing squareLocalResolutionComparison is a_q followed by b_f. These are compositions of specified actual isomorphisms, with no choices of unproved data.

source.place: Tags 01E4, 01FB, 0D5T and 0D5X; the indicated resolution and normalization calculation

proof.text: Compose the standard right-derived resolution comparison, exact forgetful homology comparison, the prescribed R.sections, the extension homology comparison and mapExtendIso. This constructs the classical comparison a_q.

Eliminate U=f inverse V. Use the augmentation Iota of I to identify F[0] with Q(I), compute inverse-open hypercohomology on the K-injective complex I, then compose exact evaluation and inverse local Leray. This constructs b_f with the same normalization as squareLocalResolutionComparison.
Unfold these three isomorphism expressions. Functoriality of isomorphism composition, cancellation of identity transports and associativity give the factorization.

        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj I.cochainComplex).homology (q : ℤ)
